_readme: LEVEL 2 GUIDE: same format as Tutorials/Level_01/guide.json (see its _readme, _targets and _triggers, and Documentation/LevelGuideTutorial/README.md).
Level 2 teaches only what is new. Movement, looking, the HUD and the desk were taught in Level 1, so they are not repeated here.
The guide only observes: it never changes the case, the review phase, rewards or documents.
Later Level 2 tickets add short lessons for the first finding, the toolkit and the stamp reason.
Fields starting with '_' are notes and are ignored by the game.

welcome.title: Something Does Not Match
welcome.subtitle: ONE MARKET CLIENT · ONE PREPARED SUMMARY
welcome.tagline: Check Aling Rosa's income summary against the records behind it.

_waypoints: Where the arrows lead for each Level_02/objectives.json step. 'step' must match the step's trigger exactly.

pages.text: Welcome back! Today you have one client: Aling Rosa, who runs an alterations stall at the market.
Someone already filled in her income summary. Your job is to check it, not just accept it.
Start at the front desk. Follow the arrows to the receptionist and tap to talk.
Rosa's folder is in the market-client drawer. Follow the arrows to the file storage room.
Got it! Rosa's folder is in your folder icon. Sit at your desk, then drag it from the icon onto the desk.
Tap the arrow at the bottom right of the paper to turn the page. Read the cover, Rosa's May summary and the referral note.
A filled page can still need checking. Find the record behind the entry.
The referral note asks about a paid commission. Look at Rosa's May summary. Is that payment on it?
When something doesn't match, write a finding. Turn to the last page of the folder: Findings.
Here's the first step. Tap a line on the May summary to pick it up, turn to Findings and tap Concern.
Your turn: put a referral note line in Related record, then tap a Choice and put it in Reason.
Good. While that concern is open, this work isn't ready. Let's say so on the folder.
Your turn: tap the stamp set on your desk, then drag a stamp onto the front page of Rosa's folder.
Rosa's stall is near the plaza. Follow the arrows and talk to her about the records.
Rosa gave you six records. Sit at the records desk beside her stall to look at them.
